summary: The Boston Globe reported that Rapid7 cut about 300 jobs, or roughly 12% of its workforce, as new CEO Wael Mohamed overhauls the cybersecurity company amid a focus on adding AI-powered features.
evidenceQuote: New CEO Wael Mohamed is overhauling the struggling company amid a focus on adding AI-powered features.
notes: The Boston Globe ties the cuts to an overhaul and AI-powered product focus, while also describing business pressure and falling revenue as factors. This is classified as AI-adjacent restructuring rather than direct AI replacement.

sources.name: The Boston Globe
sources.quote: Boston cybersecurity firm Rapid7 cuts 300 jobs.
